name: Guangergaozhi AI Chat and SEO Sync
author: GUANGERGAOZHI

sections.description:
GrowthOS connects a WordPress website to the GrowthOS SaaS platform. After activation with a GrowthOS license code, site owners can enable an AI chat widget, synchronize public site content, and publish approved SEO/GEO metadata and structured data back to WordPress pages, posts and supported product content.

Main capabilities:

  • Activate or reconnect a WordPress site with a GrowthOS license code.
  • Sync public pages, posts, categories, WooCommerce products and product categories to GrowthOS.
  • Render an AI chat widget on the storefront without exposing the GrowthOS site token in browser code.
  • Inject approved SEO/GEO title, meta description, AI summary, Open Graph, Twitter and JSON-LD data into WordPress pages.
  • Poll GrowthOS jobs for approved article publishing and SEO/GEO updates.
  • Configure chat theme colors and avatar from the WordPress admin screen.

External services

This plugin connects to the GrowthOS SaaS service. By default, requests are sent to https://open.tui161.com; site administrators can change the API endpoint in the plugin settings.

The plugin sends public site content and selected metadata to GrowthOS for content synchronization, AI chat configuration, SEO/GEO analysis and publishing workflows. Chat messages submitted by visitors are proxied through WordPress REST endpoints to GrowthOS so the GrowthOS site token is not exposed in visitor browsers.

Service provider: GUANGERGAOZHI / GrowthOS

Terms of service: https://www.tui161.com/legal/growthos-ai-connector/terms

Privacy policy: https://www.tui161.com/legal/growthos-ai-connector/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/growthos/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the GrowthOS menu in WordPress admin.
  4. Confirm the Cloud API Base URL.
  5. Paste the GrowthOS license code generated in the GrowthOS SaaS admin panel.
  6. Click Activate / Reconnect.
  7. Enable AI chat and SEO/GEO injection as needed, then sync site content.
sections.faq:
Do I need a GrowthOS account?

Yes. The plugin requires a GrowthOS SaaS account and a site license code before cloud synchronization, AI chat and SEO/GEO publishing can work.

Does the plugin expose my GrowthOS site token to visitors?

No. Visitor chat requests are proxied through WordPress REST endpoints. The GrowthOS site token is stored in WordPress options and used server-side.

Can I disable the AI chat widget?

Yes. The chat widget can be disabled from the GrowthOS plugin settings page.

Can I disable SEO/GEO injection?

Yes. SEO/GEO head output can be disabled from the GrowthOS plugin settings page.

What content is synchronized?

The plugin synchronizes public WordPress pages, posts, categories, WooCommerce products and product categories, including URLs, titles, excerpts and selected metadata needed for GrowthOS workflows.
